test_title: PYST 37: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Tom will _______ the document to the office tomorrow.
solution:
The correct answer is '**mail**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**mail**" refers to sending documents or items via postal service or email.
 
• The sentence indicates that Tom will send the document to the office tomorrow, which aligns with the meaning of "mail."
 
• The other options: "**mall**," "**meal**," and "**male**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Tom will mail__ the document to the office tomorrow.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mall**: refers to a shopping complex.
 
• **Meal**: refers to food eaten at a specific time.
 
• **Male**: refers to the masculine gender.
